subject.title: Overview Event Log and Gateway Log panels do not stay aligned when their content heights differ

question: Which repository owns the OpenClaw 2026.3.14 gateway Overview UI, and should this issue be transferred there?
rationale: Current ClawHub source proves the named panels are outside its internal route and component surface, but the available evidence does not identify the destination repository precisely enough for automated routing.

options.title: Transfer to owning repository
options.body: Identify the gateway dashboard source and transfer or recreate the report there with its existing reproduction details.

options.title: Request precise route evidence
options.body: Ask the reporter for the exact current URL, screenshot, and source checkout path before selecting the destination.

recommendation.title: Transfer to owning repository
recommendation.body: Identify the gateway dashboard source and transfer or recreate the report there with its existing reproduction details.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged dashboard and navigation work makes them the strongest adjacent ClawHub history candidate to confirm the product boundary.
